_purpose: What the data can and cannot answer. build_mart.py fails if a 'loaded' topic's mart tables are empty. The chatbot answers a question that needs a 'not_loaded' topic with the note instead of running SQL.

topics.note: Yearly demand, collection, opening and closing balance, collection efficiency, for the division and each sub-division, 2015-16 to 2025-26.
The same figures per tariff family (LT-1 ... HT-7, miscellaneous), per tariff-booklet category (LT-4(a), HT-2(b), LT-6(b) ...) and per tariff slab.

The CESC tariff booklet FY2025-26 to FY2027-28 (KERC order 27.03.2025): every category and sub-category, who it applies to, fixed / demand and energy rates for the three years, and the general rules (interest, tax, reconnection, power factor, ToD, rebates, DERS, open-access charges). Rates for years before 2025-26 are not in it.
Total, live, billed and DC/MNR installations and connected load at year end.
Metered, assessed and total energy consumption billed, in units.

AT&C loss = 100 - billing efficiency x collection efficiency, with the sheet's billing efficiency (installations billed / live), for the division, each sub-division, family and booklet category, every year.
Collections split into cash / cheque and adjustments; the adjustment is the Government subsidy (confirmed by CESC): almost all of it Gruha Jyothi for LT-1 domestic and the IP-set subsidy for LT-4(a).
The DCB statement in this data is yearly: one figure per fiscal year, so monthly, quarterly or daily figures can't be given.
This data has totals per sub-division and tariff slab only; it holds no individual consumers, accounts or RR numbers.

Only Holenarasipura Division is in this data (its sub-divisions Arkalgud, Hangarahalli, Holenarasipura, Ramanathapura, Saligrama and the Konanur section); other CESCOM divisions and other ESCOMs are not.

Energy input, feeders, transformers, energy (technical) losses and outages are not in the DCB statement. AT&C loss is available on the sheet's own billing-efficiency basis: 100 - billing efficiency (installations billed / live) x collection efficiency.

Collections are split only into cash/cheque and adjustments in this data; payment channels such as online or UPI are not recorded. (How bills may be paid is in the tariff booklet: up to Rs 10,000 by cash, DD or digital payment; above that by cheque, DD or digital payment.)
Staff and organisation records are not part of this billing data.
